EXXARO.NS.d: Exxaro Tiles Limited produces and distributes vitrified tiles as flooring solutions in India and internationally. Under the Exxaro brand, its range includes double charge and glazed vitrified tiles and wall tiles, supplied through a network of dealers and distributors.

Incorporated in 1984 as Sanjay Leasing Limited, it adopted its current name in March 2012 and is headquartered in Mumbai.

FSL.NS.d: Firstsource Solutions Limited provides customized business process management services in India, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Philippines, and internationally.

GLOTTIS.NS.d: Glottis Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker GLOTTIS and traded in INR. Its country is India.

GOLDIAM.NS.d: Goldiam International Limited and its subsidiaries make and sell diamond-studded jewelry in gold, silver and platinum in India, through jewellery manufacturing and investment segments. Its range includes engagement and wedding rings, bridal sets, earrings, pendants and necklaces. Incorporated in 1986 and based in Mumbai, it exports to the US, the Middle East, Europe, Australia and Canada.

GUJALKALI.NS.d: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited engages in the production and sale of various chemical products in India. It provides caustic soda lye, soda flake, and soda prill, liquid chlorine, hydrochloric acid, and compressed hydrogen gas; anhydrous aluminum chloride, chlorinated paraffin, benzyl alcohol, benzaldehyde, and benzyl chloride; and sodium chlorate. The company also offers caustic potash lye and flakes, and potassium carbonate; methylene chloride, chloroform, and carbon tetrachloride; and phosphoric acid.

HARDWYN.NS.d: Hardwyn India Limited is a New Delhi-based supplier of architectural hardware and aluminum products, founded in 1965, selling in India and overseas under the Hardwyn brand. Its range includes door closers, hinges, handles and locks, glass fittings, shower enclosures, plastic profiles, automatic doors, stainless steel railings, electronic safes and bathroom accessories.

HGINFRA.NS.d: H.G. Infra Engineering Limited engages in the engineering, procurement, and construction business in India. It constructs and maintains roads, bridges, flyovers, and other infrastructure contract works. The company offers civil construction projects comprising extension and grading of runways, railways, and land development. It also undertakes water pipeline projects. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Jaipur, India.

INDOCO.NS.d: Indoco Remedies Limited manufactures and sells formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients in India and internationally. The company offers respiratory products, such as Karvol Plus, Febrex Plus, and Tuspel; stomatologicals products that include Sensodent-K, Sensoform, Sensodent-KF, Snowdent, Kidodent, Rexidin Plus, and Dentogel; gastro intestinal products, such as Carmicide, Cyclopam, Carmicide Drops, Cyclomeff, and Nosic; pain/analgesics products that include Lignox and T-lac; and opthalmological…

INTEGRA.NS.d: Integra Garments and Textiles Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, it was involved in manufacturing garments in India. The company was formerly known as Five Star Mercantile Limited and changed its name to Integra Garments and Textiles Limited in August 2012. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Mumbai, India. Integra Garments and Textiles Limited is a subsidiary of Ashok Piramal Group Textile Trust.

IOC.NS.d: Indian Oil Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the refining, pipeline transportation, and marketing of petroleum products in India. It is also involved in the exploration and production of crude oil and gas; and marketing of natural gas and petrochemicals. The company's products include petrol/gasoline, diesel/gas oil, lubricants and greases, auto gas, cooking gas, kerosene, LPG, bulk/industrial fuels, aviation fuel, marine oils, and bitumen.

JINDALSTEL.NS.d: Jindal Steel & Power Limited operates in the steel, power, mining, and infrastructure sectors in Asia, Africa, Australia, and the Middle East. It operates through Iron and Steel Products, Power, and Others segments. The company offers track and crane rails, and flash-butt welded rail panels; and medium and heavy hot rolled parallel flange beams and column sections for use in refineries, metro rail projects, airports, flyovers, power plants, highways, malls, and high rise buildings.

JSIPL.NS.d: Jindal Supreme (India) Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker JSIPL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

JYOTIRES.NS.d: Jyoti Resins and Adhesives Limited is an Indian company specializing in the manufacturing and sale of wood adhesives. They primarily serve the furniture and woodworking industries. The company is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

KAMATHOTEL.NS.d: Kamat Hotels (India) Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the hospitality business in India. It operates hotels and resorts under the brands, such as The Orchid, Fort Jadhavgadh, and Lotus Konark Resorts, as well as Mahodadhi Palace. The company also operates restaurants; and provides hotel consultancy, setups, and other related services. Kamat Hotels (India) Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.

KRIDHANINF.NS.d: Kridhan Infra Limited manufactures and sells ready to use steel products for the construction and infrastructure sectors in India and internationally. The company offers bridge expansion joints for asphalt and concrete connection; and rebar mechanical couplers. It also provides bored piling, driven piling, micro piling and soil improvement, and soil investigation services. The company was formerly known as Readymade Steel India Limited and changed its name to Kridhan Infra Limited in June 2014.

LOKESHMACH.NS.d: Lokesh Machines Limited manufactures and sells machine tools in India. The company operates in two segments, Machine Tool and Component divisions. It offers CNC machines, including CNC lathes, vertical and horizontal machining centers, drill and tap centers, turn mill centers, and vertical turning centers.

MEDICAPQ.NS.d: Medi-Caps Limited is engaged in education and operates educational institutions. They provide courses in engineering, management, pharmacy, and other disciplines. The company is located in India.

METALFORGE.NS.d: Metalyst Forgings Limited manufactures and sells forged automotive components primarily in India. It has a product portfolio with a range of engineered components, including camshafts, connecting rods, crankshaft, crown wheel pinions, and front axle beams. The company provides components for two/three wheelers, passenger cars, tractors, light commercial vehicles (LCV), heavy commercial vehicles (HCV), and stationary engines. In addition, it exports its products.

MOL.NS.d: Meghmani Organics Limited produces pigments and agrochemicals for India and global markets. Its green and blue pigments go into printing inks, paints, coatings and plastics, while its agrochemicals include insecticides like cypermethrin, chlorpyriphos and fipronil and herbicides such as triclopyr. Ahmedabad is its headquarters, and it dates from 1986.

MOMSBELIEF.NS.d: Rays of Belief Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker MOMSBELIEF and traded in INR. Its country is India.

NAVINFLUOR.NS.d: Navin Fluorine International Limited manufactures and sells specialty fluorochemicals in India and internationally. The company offers refrigerants to OEMs, service technicians, and equipment owners under the Mafron brand name for use in various applications, including window and split room air conditioners, chillers, packaged air conditioners, commercial and industrial refrigeration units, intermediate for API's, fluoropolymer resins, domestic and industrial refrigerators, and mobile air conditioning.

NELCAST.NS.d: Nelcast Limited manufactures and sells ductile and grey iron castings in India and internationally. The company provides commercial components, including bogie suspension brackets, conventional suspension/engine/steering/cab mounting brackets, rear and forward differential carriers, flanged and plain half products, wheel hubs, bearing caps, brake drums, and brake disc rotors; and tractor/farm components comprising hydraulic lift covers, and front engine support, as well as axle, four-wheel drive front axle,…

POEL.NS.d: POCL Enterprises Limited is engaged in trading and investment activities. The company operates in the financial services sector. Its headquarters are located in India.

PRASOLCHEM.NS.d: Prasol Chemicals Limited is an integrated Indian maker of acetone and phosphorous derivatives for pharmaceutical, agrochemical, home and personal care, and performance chemical customers. Its specialty chemicals are raw materials in sunscreens, shampoos, fragrances, disinfectants, medicines such as antidepressants, and crop protection formulations.

PTC.NS.d: PTC India Limited, operating alongside its various subsidiaries, is actively engaged in the commerce of electricity throughout India, Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh, including international cross-border transactions. The company manages power deals ranging from short-term to medium-term and long-term arrangements. Furthermore, it offers project financing, providing investment capital and funding solutions for initiatives within the power sector and related segments of the energy value chain.

SAMHI.NS.d: SAMHI Hotels Limited is an Indian company that develops and invests in hotels and acts as a hotel ownership and asset management platform. Its properties are mostly in major cities such as the National Capital Region, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune, under brands including Courtyard By Marriott, Hyatt Regency, Sheraton and Caspia. Founded in 2010, it is based in Gurugram.

SANWARIA.NS.d: Sanwaria Consumer Limited operates as an integrated agro food processor in India. The company manufactures and sells basmati rice; pulses, poha, sugar, soya chunks, and wheat flour; other food grain products, including soya meal and edible oil, as well as refined and crude oil; rice flour, salt, suji, maida, besan, and daliya; rice bran and its products; and de-oiled cake. It operates retail stores under the Sanwaria Kirana brand name, as well as sells its products online.

SHAILY.NS.d: Shaily Engineering Plastics Limited, founded in 1980 and headquartered in Vadodara, India, manufactures precision injection-molded plastic parts. These components go into pharmaceutical products such as pumps, sprays, insulin pens and medicine containers, as well as kitchenware, household goods, toys and items for the cosmetics industry.

SHIGAN.NS.d: Shigan Quantum Technologies Ltd. is an India-based company that operates as an alternative fuel system solution provider and a manufacturer of components for the automotive, locomotive, and stationary engine applications. The company specializes in designing, developing, and manufacturing systems for various green mobility solutions including hydrogen, biofuels, natural gas (CNG and LNG), and LPG.

SIEL.NS.d: Superior Industrial Enterprises Limited is an Indian company engaged in manufacturing and trading of various products. The company operates in various sectors. It is based in India.

SKMEGGPROD.NS.d: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Limited manufactures and supplies egg products in India, Japan, Russia, Europe, and internationally. The company offers various egg powders, including whole egg powder for use in biscuits, cakes, bakery mixes, pasta, sauces, dressings, ready meals, quiches, omelets, mayonnaise, meat products, and other emulsified systems; egg yolk powder for use in mayonnaises, dressings, sauces, Spanish bread, croissants, pasta, and ice-cream; and egg albumen powder for use in bakery, pastry,…

SKYWAYS.NS.d: Skyways Air Services Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SKYWAYS and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SUMEDHA.NS.d: Sumedha Fiscal Services Limited is an Indian financial services company. The company offers services like investment banking and wealth management. Sumedha Fiscal Services Limited is based in Mumbai, India.

SUPTANERY.NS.d: Super Tannery Limited is involved in the processing and export of leather. The company manufactures finished leather and leather products. Super Tannery Limited is based in India.

SURAKSHA.NS.d: Suraksha Diagnostic Limited runs a network of diagnostic centers across India. Its testing menu spans pathology, genomics, radiology imaging such as X-ray, MRI, CT and mammography, and cardiology tests including electrocardiograms and echocardiograms.

TARSONS.NS.d: Tarsons Products Limited, a Kolkata company founded in 1983, manufactures and distributes laboratory plastics and scientific instruments around the world. Its catalog covers disposable labware, centrifuge and cryogenic equipment, liquid handling systems, safety products, bottles, cell culture products, pipette tips and petri dishes.

TATAPOWER.NS.d: The Tata Power Company Limited engages in the generation, transmission, distribution, and trading of electricity in India and internationally. It operates through Generation, Renewables, Transmission and Distribution, and Others segments. The Generation segment generates electricity from hydroelectric and thermal sources, such as coal, gas, and oil. The Renewables segment generates power from renewable energy sources, which include wind and solar.

TEXMOPIPES.NS.d: Texmo Pipes and Products Limited engages in the manufacture and trading of plastic products in India and internationally. It provides CPVC, SWR, and plumbing pipes and fittings; submersible column pipes; rigid PVC pipes and agricultural fittings; casing pipes for tube wells; HDPE coils; PLB HDPE ducts; and HDPE sprinkler pipes and fittings. The company also offers drip irrigation systems; suction hoses; garden and conduit pipes; and solvent cement products for joining RPVC pipes and fittings under the TEXMO brand.

TGBHOTELS.NS.d: TGB Banquets and Hotels Limited provides restaurant, banquet, and hotel services in India and internationally. It operates hotels under The Grand Bhagwati name in Ahmedabad. The company also offers dining under the Café Piano and Mr. & Mrs. Somani name; and catering services. In addition, it operates convention centers under The Grand Bhagwati name, as well as clubs and events.

THYROCARE.NS.d: Thyrocare Technologies Limited provides diagnostic testing services to patients, laboratories, and hospitals in India. The company operates through Diagnostic Testing Services, Imaging Services, and Others segments. It conducts medical diagnostic tests and profiles of tests that focuses on early detection and management of disorders and diseases, including thyroid, growth, metabolism, auto-immunity, diabetes, anaemia, cardiovascular, infertility, and various infectious diseases.

TMB.NS.d: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Limited is an Indian bank organized into Treasury, Corporate and Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking and other banking operations. It offers savings, recurring, term and current deposit accounts, debit and credit cards, demat and equity trading accounts, bill payments, mutual funds, sovereign gold bonds and insurance products.

TTL.NS.d: T.T. Limited manufactures and sells textiles in India. The company's products include raw cotton; cotton yarn for knitting and weaving; various knitted fabrics; knitted innerwear; garments for men, ladies, and kids; and cotton and polyster sewing threads.

VETO.NS.d: Veto Switchgears and Cables Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells wires and cables, and electrical accessories in India and internationally. It operates through Wire and Cables, Lighting & Fittings, and Accessories & Others segments. It provides electrical accessories, including carino, vyoma, and power modular switches, as well as puf and zac switches; and MCBs/isolaters/distributtion boxes, and bells and extension cords.

WHEELS.NS.d: Wheels India Limited manufactures and sells automotive and industrial components in India and internationally. The company offers steel wheels for use in heavy and light vehicles, as well as for agricultural applications; off-road construction wheels, wire wheels, and forged aluminum wheels; air suspension systems for buses, trucks and trailers, control and specialty products, and other vehicle applications; and wind turbines and machined components for various other applications.

WINDLAS.NS.d: Windlas Biotech Limited is a contract development and manufacturing organisation (CDMO). Its services cover discovery, development and licensing, as well as commercial production on a large scale, of generic pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products, helping clients bring established and new products to market.

YUKEN.NS.d: Yuken India Limited and its subsidiaries make and distribute oil hydraulic equipment in India. Its products include piston, vane and gear pumps, variable displacement vane pumps, and control components such as valves for pressure, flow and direction, as well as modular valves.
